cases.name: Betty Crouch James
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Miss Betty retired from the Swint Division of the Graniteville Company. Following her retirement from the Graniteville Company, she went to work at the Chick-N-Snack. Miss Betty enjoyed fishing, trips to the lake and was an avid fan of the Atlanta Braves and the Atlanta Falcons."
